summary: Iteration 48 — MO-028 QRU Autonomous Improvement Loop™ (Civilization Status + Gold Master Candidate) full-stack validation. Backend pytest: 12/12 PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration48_improvement_loop.py in 1.45s (auth+contract+CASE A+CASE B+cycles). (1) POST /api/media-library/improvement-loop requires Bearer auth (401 without). (2) Response contract: cycles[], work_orders[], civilization_status[] (department, department_name, activity, progress:int 0-100, blocked:bool), baseline_composite, final_composite, threshold, gold_master_candidate_ready, blocking_count, notification, honest_note — all present and typed. (3) Threshold clamps: value 30 → 70; value 500 → 98; final_composite bounded 0-98. (4) CASE A (passing) — topic='forex' + full forex narration at threshold=85 returned gold_master_candidate_ready=true, blocking_count=0, final_composite>=threshold, AND every non-blocking department in civilization_status reported progress=100 / blocked=false (the exact honesty invariant that was previously broken — verified fixed). Same behaviour for topic='wellness' at threshold=85. notification contains 'Gold Master Candidate ready' and founder_actions=['YES','REQUEST CHANGES','PUBLISH']. (5) CASE B (blocked) — topic='obscure medical xyz zzz protocol' with narration mentioning 'medical health claims', threshold=95: gold_master_candidate_ready=false, blocking_count>=1, a knowledge_verification department present with blocked=true, blocking work orders routed only to knowledge_verification with resolution referencing 'verified Knowledge Record + human sign-off (governance §9)'. QA row is blocked=true (or progress<100). Notification does NOT claim 'Gold Master Candidate ready'. honest_note is always present. (6) cycles composite monotonic non-decreasing; final_composite==last cycle composite; baseline==cycle[0] composite; every work_order routed to one of the 6 valid departments with a valid status. FRONTEND Playwright at /flagship-showcase (Founder login → click 'Segment & Match'): live scene-match to Pixabay succeeded (3 scenes, forex narration), the Creative Direction Report rendered, and the Civilization Status panel (fs-loop) AUTO-appeared without user action. fs-loop-threshold slider (=90), fs-loop-rerun, fs-loop-honest-note, fs-loop-climb (Baseline 91 → After 0 cycle(s) 91 → Threshold 90) all visible. Department cards fs-loop-dept-design_intelligence and fs-loop-dept-qa rendered with fs-loop-pct-design_intelligence=100% and fs-loop-pct-qa=100% (honest — baseline already met the threshold so all active depts show Complete). Gold Master Candidate Ready card (fs-loop-candidate-ready) shown with 91/100 Treasure Standard + 2/2 Departments Complete + Awaiting Founder Approval. fs-loop-approve, fs-loop-request-changes, fs-loop-publish all visible; clicking fs-loop-approve marked the button 'Approved' (creativeApproved=true) and toast 'Gold Master Candidate approved. Ready to manufacture.' fired. No YouTube publish. No blocking case exercised via UI (backend covers that exhaustively) — but the UI has fs-loop-blocked branch wired to the same civilization_status payload, so honesty is preserved end-to-end.
action_items: OPTIONAL — improvement_loop.py::_route defaults to creative_director when no keyword matches; this is fine for the current narration pool but may silently mis-route niche recommendations in future. Consider surfacing 'unmatched' explicitly instead of a silent default.

OPTIONAL — civilization_status may contain only a subset of the 6 defined departments (only those with active work orders + always QA). The UI correctly handles this dynamically, but a Founder glancing at the dashboard might wonder where the other depts are. Consider adding a small legend 'Departments idle for this run' or always render all 6 with a 'Standby' state (progress=100, activity='Standing by').

OPTIONAL — sensitive-topic list in improvement_loop.py is hardcoded (medical, health, financial, forex, invest, trading, legal). Consider centralizing with the same list used by Knowledge Manufacturing so a single edit keeps governance in sync.
critical_code_review_comments: improvement_loop.py::run_loop — the honesty fix (lines 141-152) correctly upgrades non-blocking work_orders to progress=100 when gold_candidate or ceiling met. Verified end-to-end: no department shows 0% when candidate is ready. Blocking work orders are locked to progress=100 with 'Blocked — human input required' status so the UI can display 'Blocked' without confusion with 'Complete'.

improvement_loop.py::_recommendations — recs list is derived from cd report signals only (no fabrication). If no signal fires it defaults to a single 'polish pacing' rec so there's always at least one work order and the civilization is never empty — reasonable default but the min-1 recommendation should be documented in the honesty note.

improvement_loop.py — sensitive-topic detection scans both topic AND narration for keywords; the OR gate + `not kr_ok` correctly gates blocking. Verified: 'obscure medical xyz zzz' has no verified KR → knowledge_verification.blocking=true; 'forex' has a verified KR → knowledge_verification.blocking=false (no blocking WO even though the topic is sensitive). This is exactly the Knowledge-First guarantee.

improvement_loop.py::civilization_status — QA row is appended manually at progress=100 if no blocking else 60, blocked=bool(blocking_orders). Correct honest signal — but 60% is arbitrary; consider deriving from cycles_completed / max_cycles or from cd_approved ratio for auditability.

routers/media_library.py::improvement_loop — ImprovementInput accepts `scenes: list` without a nested SceneInput model (same pattern as creative-direction). Consider tightening with a Pydantic sub-model for consistent 422s on malformed payloads.

FlagshipShowcase.js::runLoop — auto-runs after fetchCreative; correctly resets deptAnim + candidateDecision on each run; animated bar fill via setTimeout(120ms, target) is a nice touch. approveCandidate sets creativeApproved=true which participates in canProduce gate — cross-wiring is minimal and correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (fs-loop auto-appears after Segment & Match, threshold slider + re-run button + honest note + climb summary + department progress bars + Gold Master Candidate Ready card with score/N of N/approve/request-changes/publish + Approve click transitions button to 'Approved' and toasts success — all verified)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Loop runs write into db.improvement_runs (audit trail) — expected side effect, not test-created content.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MO-028 QRU Autonomous Improvement Loop™ is validated end-to-end. Backend pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration48_improvement_loop.py (~1.5s, requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). Frontend testids stable: fs-loop, fs-loop-threshold, fs-loop-rerun, fs-loop-working, fs-loop-departments, fs-loop-dept-<dept>, fs-loop-pct-<dept>, fs-loop-climb, fs-loop-candidate-ready, fs-loop-approve, fs-loop-request-changes, fs-loop-publish, fs-loop-blocked, fs-loop-wo-<id>, fs-loop-honest-note. Honesty invariant to guard on future refactors: (a) when gold_master_candidate_ready=true, EVERY non-blocking civilization_status entry MUST report progress=100 and blocked=false — no dept stuck at 0%; (b) when a sensitive topic has no verified KR, gold_master_candidate_ready MUST be false AND a knowledge_verification blocked=true row MUST appear. Both are enforced by the pytest suite. Live scene-match to Pixabay is used before the loop — allow 60-90s network budget on cold cache.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature validation for MO-028 (Autonomous Improvement Loop™) that closes out the previously reported honesty bug where non-blocking departments could show 0% while the candidate was reported ready. Root cause of prior bug (documented in iteration_47 handoff): when the baseline composite already passed the threshold on cycle 0, the cycles loop exited without iterating work_orders, so wo.progress remained at 0 for every dept. Mitigation implemented in improvement_loop.py lines 141-152 (post-loop upgrade block): for every non-blocking work order, if gold_candidate OR dims[dim] >= ceiling then set progress=100/status=Complete else compute honest partial progress from base_dims. Verified by test TestCaseA_Passing.test_forex_reaches_gold_master (asserts every non-blocking cs.progress==100 when candidate is ready).
